## Codex publication boundary

Treat repository review, local edits, pushing a branch, opening or updating a PR, and merging as distinct effects. Verify the target repository and current user authorization for each external write. If push or PR publication is not yet authorized, complete the local branch, diff, checks, and draft PR text so approval is the final step. Do not merge unless separately requested. Preserve the upstream review and CI workflow within those boundaries.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Find failing PR checks, inspect logs or external check links, and apply focused fixes
proof: Pinned source hash, deterministic build, frontmatter parser, link check, security scan; live behavior pending where stated in manifest.
reason: Namespaced frontmatter prevents collisions; Codex boundary note is added where runtime or naming requires it. Git/PR effects are explicitly separated under Codex permissions.

codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Find failing PR checks, inspect logs or external check links, and apply focused fixes

native_mapping.fallback: Report the exact missing dependency; do not complete or substitute that step.

permission_gates: Current operator authorization and native permissions govern actions. Source distribution grants no activation.

behavioral_proof.positive: Source coverage and deterministic rendering checked; live operation not executed.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: Instructions require an exact capability gap and incomplete step; live failure path not executed.
behavioral_proof.error: Native permissions and refusal remain binding; live error path not executed.
